question: Where was the Khelo India University Games 2024 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhubaneswar, Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Khelo India University Games 2024 were held in **Bhubaneswar, Odisha**, showcasing top university-level athletes from across India.
 
• Odisha has emerged as a prominent hub for sports in India, hosting several high-profile events, including the **Hockey World Cup**.
 
• The event aims to promote sports culture and identify young talent at the grassroots level, aligning with the **Khelo India initiative**.
 
• State-of-the-art facilities in Bhubaneswar, such as the Kalinga Stadium, were utilized for the games.
 
• The Khelo India University Games focus on fostering competitive spirit among university athletes and encouraging physical fitness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Initiative:** Launched by the Government of India to promote sports at the grassroots level and provide financial assistance to promising athletes.
 
• **Kalinga Stadium:** A world-class sports complex located in Bhubaneswar, known for hosting national and international tournaments.
 
• **Odisha's Sports Infrastructure:** The state government has heavily invested in sports infrastructure, making Odisha a key destination for events like the Khelo India University Games.
 
• **University Games Objective:** To provide a platform for young athletes to showcase their talents and prepare for higher levels of competition, including international events.
 
• **Previous Edition:** The first Khelo India University Games were held in 2020 in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, and became a model for subsequent editions.
